'''Selon Mountain''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] located in the [[D'olop Mountain Range]] on [[M'haeli/Legends|M'haeli]]. It housed a secret [[dragite crystal]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]]<ref name="ROC 3" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="Date note">''[[Star Wars Legends Epic Collection: The Rebellion Vol. 3]]'' establishes that the events of ''[[Star Wars: River of Chaos]]'' take place "many [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]]" after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref>
